name: rosetta-pinstripe-display
code:
use Raster.IMAGE

let width = 640
let height = 400

let image = IMAGE(width, height)

for y in 0..height do
    let band = y * 4 / height + 1

    for x in 0..width do
        let shade = if x / band % 2 == 0 then 255ub else 0ub fi

        image.set_pixel(x, y, shade, shade, shade)
    od
od

image.write("pinstripe.png")

image.show("pinstripe.png")
